mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_name, address_phone, address_detail) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{addressName}, #{addressPhone}, #{addressDetail})

INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, selected_spec, price, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{selectedSpec}, #{price}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_name, address_phone, address_detail, create_time, shipped_time, refunded_time, express_company, express_no, express_courier, express_status, received_time, confirmed_time, sender_name, sender_address, sender_phone FROM `order` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, address_name, address_phone, address_detail, create_time, shipped_time, refunded_time, express_company, express_no, express_courier, express_status, received_time, confirmed_time, sender_name, sender_address, sender_phone FROM `order` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET shipped_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `order` SET refunded_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE `order` SET status = 'shipped', shipped_time = NOW(), express_company = #{expressCompany}, express_no = #{expressNo}, express_courier = #{expressCourier}, express_status = 'delivering' WHERE id = #{id}
